name: Wilderness bosses

variantInfo.name: Callisto
notes: Multi-way bear boss; weak to magic. Artio is the singles-plus alternative for the same task.

variantInfo.name: Artio
notes: Singles-plus, lower-level version of Callisto; 450 Hitpoints, max hit 50 (magic). No stated elemental weakness.

variantInfo.name: Venenatis
notes: Multi-way spider boss; lowest defence is crush and it is 25% weak to fire. Spindel is the singles-plus alternative.

variantInfo.name: Spindel
notes: Singles-plus version of Venenatis; 515 Hitpoints, 25% weakness to fire spells. Access needs the hard Wilderness diary or an active Venenatis boss task.

variantInfo.name: Vet'ion
notes: Multi-way undead skeleton boss with a second phase; Calvar'ion is the singles-plus alternative.

variantInfo.name: Calvar'ion
notes: Singles-plus version of Vet'ion; undead, 150 Hitpoints, max hit 26. Access needs the hard Wilderness diary or an active Vet'ion boss task.

variantInfo.name: Chaos Elemental
locations: West of the Rogues' Castle, deep Wilderness
notes: Disarms and teleports the player; weak to magic (air). Multi-way, deep Wilderness.

variantInfo.name: Chaos Fanatic
locations: West of the Lava Maze, ~Level 38+ Wilderness
notes: Low-defence demi-boss weak to ranged; casts an unavoidable magic special. Multi-way.

variantInfo.name: Crazy archaeologist
locations: Ruins south of the Forgotten Cemetery, ~Level 23 Wilderness
notes: Ranged demi-boss with a 'Rain of Knowledge' special; low melee defence. Multi-way.

variantInfo.name: Scorpia
notes: Heals from her guardian minions and is weak to magic (fire). Multi-way cave.

locationComparison.name: Various boss locations
notes: Meta-task placeholder: each Wilderness boss has its own arena, access requirements and safespot behaviour.
Most of these arenas are multi-way Wilderness (the singles-plus alternatives Artio, Spindel and Calvar'ion are the exceptions), so player-killer risk is high.
Density is not a meaningful figure for a boss task, so amount is left unknown.

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 274 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for the Wilderness bosses task is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
META-TASK. Krystilia assigns a single Wilderness bosses task (3-35, weight 8) that requires the 'Like a boss' unlock (200 Slayer reward points); one boss from the set is rolled per assignment.

The set is Callisto/Artio, Venenatis/Spindel, Vet'ion/Calvar'ion, Chaos Elemental, Chaos Fanatic, Crazy archaeologist and Scorpia. King Black Dragon is NOT part of Krystilia's boss set (verified on the live wiki 2026-07-02) and Revenants are a separate Krystilia task.

The paired singles-plus bosses (Artio, Spindel, Calvar'ion) are lower-level alternatives that count for the same task; Spindel and Calvar'ion need the hard Wilderness diary or an active parent-boss task to enter.
Every kill must occur in the Wilderness, so bring only low-risk gear and a one-click escape teleport; most arenas are multi-way with player-killer risk.
The boss pre-selection machinery (SLAYER_TARGET_BOSSID varbit 4723) still applies; the rolled boss is a live-capture QA item.
recommendedMethod: A Wilderness bosses task rolls one boss from Krystilia's set (Callisto/Artio, Venenatis/Spindel, Vet'ion/Calvar'ion, Chaos Elemental, Chaos Fanatic, Crazy archaeologist, Scorpia) and requires the 'Like a boss' unlock (200 points). Gear to the specific boss rolled - each has its own strategy - and prefer the singles-plus alternatives (Artio, Spindel, Calvar'ion) to reduce player-killer risk. Wear low-risk gear and keep a one-click escape teleport ready, since these are Wilderness kills.
